# Bijou AI

> Done-for-you, fully managed AI agents for US & EU businesses. Bijou AI builds, deploys, and manages WhatsApp and Telegram AI agents for you — they reply instantly, book appointments, and qualify leads 24/7. Not a DIY chatbot builder: a managed AI automation service where the setup and ongoing operations are done for you.

## What Bijou AI is

- Done-for-you managed AI agents (AI automation agency model) for US & EU small and medium businesses.
- Channels: WhatsApp and Telegram. The AI answers customer enquiries, books appointments (Cal.com), captures and qualifies leads, and escalates to a human when needed.
- Fully managed: Bijou builds the agent, connects your knowledge base, deploys it, and runs it for you on an ongoing basis. Clients do not have to build or maintain anything.
- Multi-language support (English, plus additional languages) with a knowledge base grounded in your own content.

## Pricing (USD only)

- Setup: $2,500 one-time.
- Managed plan: $499/month (done-for-you managed).
- Larger plan: $1,500/month.
- Enterprise: custom pricing.
